name: How does generating a Knowledge Graph actually improve my AI visibility or search performance?

mainEntity.name: How does generating a Knowledge Graph actually improve my AI visibility or search performance?

acceptedAnswer.text: A well-built graph improves AI visibility by connecting fragmented data into contextual networks, enabling machines to understand relationships and meaning rather than just isolated keywords, which boosts search relevance and decision-making accuracy.
